content.heading: About VALTRIX
paragraphs: VALTRIX is a precision manufacturer of ultra-high-purity fluid control components for semiconductor, biopharmaceutical, LED/display, solar and hydrogen energy industries. Our product range covers VCR face seal fittings, welded fittings, diaphragm valves, pressure reducers, check valves and gas filters — all manufactured from 316L stainless steel with electro-polished surface options.

Every component is produced with full material traceability, assembled in an ISO Class 4/5 cleanroom, and 100% helium leak tested before double-bagged packaging. This discipline, rooted in years of OEM manufacturing experience, is what allows VALTRIX components to meet the contamination-control demands of advanced semiconductor fabs.
From a single fitting to complete gas panels, VALTRIX provides engineering support, custom manufacturing and fast, reliable delivery worldwide.

content.heading: Quality & Certifications
paragraphs: VALTRIX operates an ISO 9001 certified quality management system covering design, machining, assembly, testing and delivery of high-purity fluid control components.

Each production lot is 100% helium mass spectrometer leak tested (sensitivity to 1x10-10 scc/s), with surface roughness measurement and particle control at every stage. Materials carry full mill certificate traceability, and assemblies are packaged in ISO Class 4/5 cleanroom conditions.

content.heading: Milestones
paragraphs: VALTRIX grew from a precision machining workshop serving international OEM customers into a dedicated manufacturer of ultra-high-purity fluid control components.

Through continuous investment in CNC machining, electro-polishing and cleanroom assembly, VALTRIX now supplies VCR face seal fittings, diaphragm valves and regulators to semiconductor and high-purity process industries worldwide.
